Acquisition is more than downloading or receiving files. It includes authorization, specification, preservation, registration, initial inspection, clarification, and an explicit acceptance decision.

## Acquisition workflow

1. **Authorize** the source, access, and intended use.
2. **Specify** expected files, tables, period, geography, format, and documentation.
3. **Receive or extract** into an approved intake location.
4. **Preserve** the delivered representation before correction or transformation.
5. **Register** project context, source, and snapshot identifiers; add a separate intake ID when the delivery pattern or consequence warrants it.
6. **Validate** enough to assess completeness and plausibility.
7. **Clarify** discrepancies with the provider or data owner.
8. **Accept or reject for staging and further organization** using an explicit status.

## Choose the acquisition type

| Type | Start here |
|---|---|
| One-time file, archive, sequence batch, raster, or field export | [Data intake](data-intake.qmd) |
| Public download or collaborator delivery | [Data intake](data-intake.qmd) |
| API, database extraction, recurring feed, or scheduled download | [Recurring and programmatic data](recurring-programmatic-data.qmd) |
| Sensor or laboratory stream | [Data intake](data-intake.qmd), then adapt the recurring-data guidance |

Use the [data-source inventory](../../templates/data-source-inventory-template.csv), [data dictionary](../../templates/data-dictionary-template.csv), [data-intake record](../../templates/data-intake-record-template.md), and [file manifest](../../templates/data-file-manifest-template.csv) as needed. The [project readiness checklist](../../templates/project-readiness-checklist.md) records the gate without requiring a separate file for every item.

::: {.callout-warning}
## Proposed minimum requirement

The [Minimum GeoEpi Project Standard](../../start/minimum-standard.qmd) requires source protection, provenance, restrictions, metadata, and result traceability. Receiving a file is not the same as accepting a dataset for staging. **Intake acceptance does not establish analytical validity, model suitability, publication readiness, or authorization for every downstream use.** Acceptance only determines whether the delivery may enter staging and further organization.
:::

## Evidence and interpretation

The workflow draws on the existing [resource catalog](../../resources/index.qmd), especially [RDMkit](https://rdmkit.elixir-europe.org/), [DataONE](https://dataone.org/best-practices/), the [FAIR Principles](https://www.go-fair.org/fair-principles/), [CARE Principles](https://www.gida-global.org/care), USDA NAL, CDC, FGDC, GBIF, EML, and EFI guidance. These sources support source preservation, provenance, metadata, access and governance, spatial documentation, epidemiological extraction context, ecological documentation, and versioned recurring data. Access date: 2026-08-05. External guidance informs this workflow but does not establish GeoEpi or institutional policy.
